title: A tab with no visible jobs shows no Totals row
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. At least one tab has no work orders (or can be emptied via the advisor/customer/asset filters).
custom_steps:
1. Open a tab that has no visible jobs (or filter until a tab is empty).
2. Look at the bottom of the tab's data area.
custom_expected: 1. The empty tab shows no Totals row (only the no-data message).
